title: The Plant That Grows at Visible Speed
hook: Right now, somewhere in a quiet forest, a green stalk is outrunning you.
script: Right now, somewhere in a quiet forest, a green stalk is outrunning you. How can a plant climb nearly a meter a day without stopping? Madake bamboo shoots water into pre-formed cells, expanding forty stem sections at once. Align a ruler with a fresh shoot, and it crosses a mark every ninety seconds. This giant plant is actually the fastest growing grass on Earth. During peak growth, entire groves crack and pop as protective sheaths burst open. An internal genetic clock forces every plant worldwide to bloom and die at once. While you sat here, a single stalk somewhere just gained another full millimeter of height.
